title: Billings or Sheridan
what_we_know: A 1951 Martinez News-Gazette item (plate 8) calls Angie "owner of the Ideal hotel" while her parents visited her in Billings. Sheridan's Ideal is documented with her from 1955 (plates 14, 15).
what_we_dont: Which Ideal the 1951 item meant. No record places her in control of either hotel in 1951.
what_might_answer_it: Billings and Sheridan city directories for 1950 to 1952; property and license records; hotel advertisements.
evidence_needed: A record naming her with the Billings Ideal, or with Sheridan's before 1955.
